Oct 25, 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Bark at SPARK: Howl-O-Ween! Calling all furry friends and spooky souls—it’s time to paw-ty! Join us for Bark at SPARK: Howl-O-Ween, a dog-friendly Halloween celebration filled with pups, people, community, and plenty of tail-wagging fun. Sunday, October 25, 2026 | 11AM–5PM The Field at SPARK Social SF 601 Mission Bay Blvd. North, San Francisco, CA Free Admission | RSVP Required All pets must be on leash. Pet-Tastic Vendors Shop treats, toys, accessories, and spooky goodies from local pet-loving businesses. Pup Cup Race | 1PM & 2PM Ready, set, lick! Each pup gets their own pup cup of whipped cream. The first pup to lick it clean wins! Costume Contest | 3PM Dress your pup in their best Halloween look and let them strut their stuff. Prizes will be awarded to the most pawsome costumes. Puppy Parade | Following Costume Contest Grab your leash and join the pack! Show off your pup’s Halloween look as we parade around the field. Breed Meet-Ups | Throughout the Day Calling all corgis, chihuahuas, golden retrievers, doodles, huskies, and every floof in between! Want to organize a breed meet-up? Email us your pup’s breed and preferred meet-up time, and we’ll help spread the word. Come celebrate Halloween with your best four-legged friend at SPARK!
